descriptionHtml:
Portable Office Cabin range

SAMAN POS India Private Limited supplies six regularly stocked portable office cabin sizes on an approved MS structural frame and insulated office build. Select the footprint first, then confirm the written specification and delivery location with the quotation.

Six published sizes and prices

SizeAreaPrice ex-GSTPrice incl. 18% GST
10×10 ft100 sq ft₹1,48,500₹1,75,230
20×8 ft160 sq ft₹2,37,600₹2,80,368
20×10 ft200 sq ft₹2,70,000₹3,18,600
20×12 ft240 sq ft₹3,11,040₹3,67,027
30×10 ft300 sq ft₹3,88,800₹4,58,784
40×10 ft400 sq ft₹5,07,600₹5,98,968

Prices use HSN 9406. Custom sizes are made to order and priced only in a written quotation.

Quotation and zonal contacts

A written quotation is returned within 48 hours. Delivery is 7–21 working days after the order and site requirements are confirmed. Delivery is free within Bangalore city and Delhi NCR; freight outside those zones is quoted separately.

South India: +91 88616 22859
North India: +91 87960 39938

Warranty: five-year structural warranty and one-year finishing warranty, subject to the written warranty and quotation terms.

Verified company credentials

SAMAN POS India Private Limited maintains the following repository-backed credentials:

  • ISO 9001:2015 quality management certificate, subject to the conditions stated in the certificate
  • GST registration, Karnataka and GST registration, Uttar Pradesh
  • Udyam registration
  • DPIIT Startup India recognition
  • NSIC Government Purchase enlistment

Frequently asked questions

Which standard Portable Office Cabin sizes are published?
Six standard sizes are published: 10x10, 20x8, 20x10, 20x12, 30x10 and 40x10 ft. Their floor areas run from 100 to 400 sq ft, and each published size is 8.5 ft high.
Are the six Portable Office Cabin sizes stocked?
Yes. The six published standard sizes are regularly stocked. Other or custom sizes are available only on quotation and are made to order.
Do the published prices include GST?
The table shows both ex-GST and inclusive prices. GST is 18% under HSN 9406.
How quickly will I receive a quotation and delivery?
SAMAN returns a written quotation within 48 hours. Delivery is 7–21 working days after the order and site requirements are confirmed.
How is freight charged?
Delivery is free within Bangalore city and Delhi NCR. Freight for destinations outside those zones is quoted separately.
What warranty applies to a Portable Office Cabin?
The warranty is five years for the structure and one year for finishing, subject to the written warranty and quotation terms.
